subject: Logic
title: Logical Equivalence Proofs
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Logical Equivalence Proofs.

hook.text: Two formulas look different but mean the same thing. How do you prove they're logically equivalent?

buildup.text: Method one: build truth tables for both and check that every row matches. Brute force but reliable.

discovery.text: Method two: use known equivalence laws—De Morgan, distribution, double negation—to transform one into the other.

twist.text: Method two is faster but requires creativity. Method one always works but grows exponentially with variables.

climax.text: Logical equivalence is the backbone of simplification—in proofs, circuits, and programming.

quiz.question: What proves two formulas logically equivalent?
